acceptedAnswer.text: Greens Ayurveda is in Azhiyur, Kozhikode (Calicut) district, Kerala, India, near Mahe.

mainEntity.name: Who leads the medical team at Greens Ayurveda?

acceptedAnswer.text: Dr. C. P. Asghar, BAMS (Kottakkal), PGDYT (KMC Manipal), the founder and Chief Physician.

mainEntity.name: What treatments and courses does Greens Ayurveda offer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Panchakarma, Kerala massages, Shirodhara, Marma and yoga therapy, plus courses of 10 days to 4 weeks.

mainEntity.name: What services did Teknoppy provide for Greens Ayurveda?

acceptedAnswer.text: SEO strategy, keyword mapping, E-E-A-T and entity structure, on-page optimisation, local SEO and schema markup.

mainEntity.name: Did Teknoppy redesign the Greens Ayurveda website?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. This was an SEO project on the existing WordPress website, ayugreen.com.

mainEntity.name: How did Teknoppy avoid keyword cannibalisation?

acceptedAnswer.text: We mapped every keyword to one page and gave treatments and courses separate search targets.

mainEntity.name: Why does E-E-A-T matter for Ayurveda websites?

acceptedAnswer.text: Health is a "Your Money or Your Life" topic, so Google favours pages that show who the doctors are and what qualifies them.

mainEntity.name: Does Teknoppy do SEO for other Ayurveda centres in Kerala?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We work with Ayurveda hospitals, resorts and wellness brands across Kerala, the UAE and Qatar.
